### Are You Willing to Yield to God?
Author: Adrian Rogers (Love Worth Finding)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-12-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 19:1, 10-11, 15
Points:
- Refusing to submit to God turns a person into hardened, unyielding clay.
- Clay that has lost its softness cannot be reshaped; it can only be broken.
- Persisting in stubborn self-will places a person in serious spiritual danger.
- God offers renewal to those who humbly repent and allow Him to reshape them.
- Receiving God's second chances requires staying pliable and responsive in His hands.
